components.description: Music features from audio, in six groups (levels, beats, tempo, notes, harmony, form): the same channel names MidiFeatures publishes, every channel on every frame, at its rest value with zero confidence where audio cannot know it. Wire an Audio In or Audio File In into audio; tonal (optional) replaces the inner Chroma, Chord and Notes with channels of the same names.

parameters.expressions:
qs = max(0, -ws);
qh = max(0, -wh)
beats = bpmNow / 60

fs = qs;
fh = qh
gr = dctSince < 0.05

jk = max(max(band109 - zk1, 0) / max(yk1 - nl, 0.08), max(band149 - zk2, 0) / max(yk2 - nl, 0.08));
kp = jk
lvb = level
nwl = nw
Pf = max(P, max(smoothstep(1.2, 2.6, fs / max(ys - nl, 0.08)), smoothstep(1.2, 2.6, fh / max(yh - nl, 0.08))))

kn = max(level / max(lvb, 0.0005) - 1, 0);
knp = kn

kR = smoothstep(0.45, 0.7, kn / max(knp, 0.05)) * smoothstep(0.05, 0.12, kn);
ks = smoothstep(0.2, 0.45, kn / max(knp, 0.05))
sense = value

hg = cx > 0.8;
cr = smoothstep(0.8, 0.95, cx)
ko = kR * G * max(P, smoothstep(0.3, 0.6, kn))

parameters.channels: root chordIndex tension energy brightness density dense

components.name: MusicFeatures

definition.description: 0 strict, 1 normal, 2 rescues a very quiet input: the gate thresholds, the range floor and the strike threshold.
definition.label: Sensitivity

definition.description: 0 quick, 1 slow: the envelope lag (0.12 to 0.52 s), the strike hold-off (1.2 to 2.4 s) and the chord hold-off (2.5 to 4.5 s).
definition.label: Smoothing

definition.description: How far the voice envelopes fall back to the ranked band means while the music is a wall of sound with a steady tempo.
definition.label: Dense Music

definition.description: Above 1: the tempo, claimed at confidence 1. 0: detect it; bpm falls back to the project tempo while nothing is detected.
definition.label: Declared BPM

definition.description: Seconds the tail of kick, snare and hat takes to fall.
definition.label: Hit Decay

definition.description: 1 guesses pitch classes from the spectral tilt when no chord, note or chroma is known; 0 leaves them at 0.
definition.label: Pitch Fallback
